answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a prism through which agents must collateralize assets to participate in consensus. Like a vine choking off unauthorized growth, staking forces attackers to lock significant capital, creating a walnut of hardened economic resistance. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces exponential capital costs, as they must purchase and stake sufficient tokens to manipulate the network, rendering the acquisition of multiple Sybil identities prohibitively expensive.
